reference: His mouth is that dry, so the thirst must be real.
sk: Ústa má také suché, že smäd musí byť skutočný.
cz: Ústa má tak suchá, že žízeň musí být skutečná.
acceptable: His mouth is that dry, so {the|his} thirst must be {real|genuine}.
His mouth is so dry that {the|his} thirst must be {real|genuine}.
His mouth is so dry {the|his} thirst must be {real|genuine}.
He has such a dry mouth that {the|his} thirst must be {real|genuine}.

mistakes.text: His mouth is {that dry, so|so dry that} {the|his} thirst {can|could|might} be real.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Can/could/might“ vyjadruje len možnosť. Istý záver z dôkazu vyjadruje „must be“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Can/could/might“ vyjadřuje jen možnost. Jistý závěr z důkazu vyjadřuje „must be“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Can/could/might” only show possibility. For a confident conclusion from evidence, use “must be”.

mistakes.text: His mouth is {that dry, so|so dry that} {the|his} thirst must {to be|is} real.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „must“ patrí holý tvar slovesa: „must be“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „must“ následuje holý tvar slovesa: „must be“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “must” use the bare verb: “must be”.

mistakes.text: His mouth is {that dry, so|so dry that} {the|his} thirst has to be real.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri logickom závere je tu bežnejšie „must be“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pro logický závěr je tady běžnější „must be“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a logical conclusion, “must be” is the more usual choice here.

mistakes.text: His mouth is so dry that {the|his} thirst is real.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Musí byť“ je záver z dôkazu, nie istý fakt; vyjadri ho cez „must be“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Musí být“ je závěr z důkazu, ne jistý fakt; vyjádři ho pomocí „must be“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This is a conclusion from evidence, not a known fact, so use “must be”.

mistakes.text: {His mouth are|His mouths are|His mouth were} {that dry, so|so dry that} the thirst must be real.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Mouth“ je v angličtine jednotné číslo, preto „his mouth is“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Mouth“ je v angličtině jednotné číslo, proto „his mouth is“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Mouth” is singular in English, so use “his mouth is”.

source_issues: SK/CZ use 'so dry that' (také suché, že / tak suchá, že) instead of 'that dry, so'; both structures accepted.
